spring:
  application:
    name: javaExperience
  datasource:
    # javaExperience MySQL의 community DB. 시작하기 안내대로 javaExperience DB를 먼저 띄운다
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/community?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community
  flyway:
    # 이미 테이블·데이터가 있는 DB(compose의 community·practice)는 V1(CREATE TABLE)을 실행하면 실패한다.
    # 그래서 기록 테이블이 없으면 "V1까지 됐다"고만 적고(baseline) V2부터 실행한다. 빈 DB면 V1부터 실제로 실행한다.
    baseline-on-migrate: true
    baseline-version: 1
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      # 스키마는 Flyway만 바꾼다(9-1). 엔티티가 테이블과 다르면 기동이 실패한다(테이블을 몰래 바꾸지 않음)
      ddl-auto: validate
    # 트랜잭션이 끝나면 커넥션을 바로 반납한다(컨트롤러·직렬화 단계까지 붙잡지 않음)
    open-in-view: false
    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true
        # 컬렉션(태그) 지연 로딩을 글마다 1번이 아니라 IN (...) 한 번으로 묶는다(2-4, N+1 대응)
        default_batch_fetch_size: 100

mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

logging:
  level:
    # 실행 SQL은 확인하되 토큰을 포함한 바인딩 값은 로그에 남기지 않는다
    org.hibernate.SQL: debug
    org.hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind: info

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.bookmark.MyBatisBookmarkFolderMapper">
    <select id="findSummaries" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkFolderSummaryResponse">
        SELECT f.id, f.name, COUNT(b.id) AS bookmarkCount
        FROM bookmark_folder f LEFT JOIN bookmark b ON b.folder_id = f.id
        WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId}
        GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.created_at
        ORDER BY f.created_at ASC, f.id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="lockMember" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
    </select>
    <select id="countByMember" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmark_folder WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <select id="countByName" resultType="int">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmark_folder
        WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND name = #{name}
        <if test="exceptId != null">AND id != #{exceptId}</if>
    </select>
    <select id="findMine" resultType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkFolderRow">
        SELECT id, name FROM bookmark_folder WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <insert id="insert" parameterType="org.example.bookmark.BookmarkFolderInsertRow"
            useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO bookmark_folder(member_id, name, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{at}, #{at})
    </insert>
    <update id="rename">
        UPDATE bookmark_folder SET name = #{name}, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </update>
    <update id="moveAllToDefault">
        UPDATE bookmark SET folder_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE folder_id = #{folderId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </update>
    <delete id="deleteMine">
        DELETE FROM bookmark_folder WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
    </delete>
</mapper>

               l.created_at AS liked_at
        FROM post_like l FORCE INDEX (ix_post_like_member_created)
        STRAIGHT_JOIN post p FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) ON p.id = l.post_id
        STRAIGHT_JOIN member a ON a.id = p.author_id
        WHERE l.member_id = #{memberId}
          AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
          AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR p.author_id = #{memberId}

          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                          WHERE b.blocker_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)

                          WHERE b.blocker_id = p.author_id AND b.blocked_id = #{memberId})

<mapper namespace="org.example.marked.MyBatisMarkedPostMapper">
    <!-- 목록과 COUNT가 동일한 공개·차단·표시 조건을 공유한다. -->
    <sql id="markedFromWhere">
        FROM post p
        JOIN member author ON author.id = p.author_id
        JOIN board board_ref ON board_ref.id = p.board_id
        LEFT JOIN post_like l ON l.post_id = p.id AND l.member_id = #{memberId}
        LEFT JOIN bookmark bm ON bm.post_id = p.id AND bm.member_id = #{memberId}
        WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block blocked
              WHERE (blocked.blocker_id = #{memberId} AND blocked.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                 OR (blocked.blocked_id = #{memberId} AND blocked.blocker_id = p.author_id))
        <choose>
            <when test="liked and bookmarked">AND l.id IS NOT NULL AND bm.id IS NOT NULL</when>
            <when test="liked">AND l.id IS NOT NULL</when>
            <when test="bookmarked">AND bm.id IS NOT NULL</when>
            <otherwise>AND (l.id IS NOT NULL OR bm.id IS NOT NULL)</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </sql>
    <select id="findMarkedPosts" resultType="org.example.marked.MarkedPostRow">
        SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title,
               author.nickname AS author_nickname, board_ref.slug AS board_slug,
               (l.id IS NOT NULL) AS liked, (bm.id IS NOT NULL) AS bookmarked
        <include refid="markedFromWhere" />
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>
    <select id="countMarkedPosts" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        <include refid="markedFromWhere" />
    </select>
</mapper>

    <sql id="likeCounts">
        FROM post p
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM post_like GROUP BY post_id) l ON l.post_id = p.id
        WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.like_count <> COALESCE(l.cnt, 0)
    </sql>
    <sql id="commentCounts">
        FROM post p
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comment
                   WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY post_id) c ON c.post_id = p.id

        SET p.comment_count = COALESCE(c.cnt, 0)
        WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.comment_count <> COALESCE(c.cnt, 0)
    </update>
</mapper>

    <select id="findMutualIds" resultType="long">

         WHERE f.follower_id = #{memberId}
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow r WHERE r.follower_id = f.followee_id AND r.followee_id = #{memberId})
         ORDER BY f.followee_id
    </select>
    <select id="findFollowBackIds" resultType="long">
        SELECT f.follower_id FROM follow f
        JOIN member m ON m.id = f.follower_id
        WHERE f.followee_id = #{memberId} AND m.member_status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow r WHERE r.follower_id = #{memberId} AND r.followee_id = f.follower_id)
        ORDER BY f.follower_id
    </select>
    <select id="findSuggestions" resultType="org.example.social.SuggestionRow">
        SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.nickname, COUNT(*) AS mutual_count
          FROM follow f1
          JOIN follow f2 ON f2.follower_id = f1.followee_id
          JOIN member m ON m.id = f2.followee_id
         WHERE f1.follower_id = #{memberId}
           AND f2.followee_id <> #{memberId}
           AND m.member_status = 'ACTIVE'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow x WHERE x.follower_id = #{memberId} AND x.followee_id = f2.followee_id)

         GROUP BY m.id, m.nickname

<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.post.PostVisibilityMapper">
    <!-- 게시판 목록과 조합 검색이 같은 조회 가능 조건을 쓴다. -->
    <sql id="viewableWhere">
        p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
        AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
             <if test="viewerId != null">
                OR p.author_id = #{viewerId}
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                           WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id)
             </if>)
        <if test="viewerId != null">
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                            WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                               OR (b.blocked_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id))
        </if>
    </sql>
    <sql id="listWhere">
        p.board_id = #{boardId} AND <include refid="viewableWhere"/>
    </sql>

    <select id="findVisibleDetail" resultType="org.example.post.PostDetailRow">
        SELECT p.id, b.slug AS board_slug, p.title, p.content, p.visibility,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname,
               p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at
        FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id
                    JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
        WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
               <if test="viewerId != null">OR (p.status = 'DRAFT' AND p.author_id = #{viewerId})</if>
               <if test="viewerRole == 'ADMIN'">OR p.status = 'HIDDEN'</if>)
          AND (p.status != 'PUBLISHED' OR p.visibility != 'FOLLOWERS'
               <if test="viewerId != null">
                   OR p.author_id = #{viewerId}
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow f
                              WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = p.author_id)
               </if>)
          <if test="viewerId != null">
              AND (p.author_id = #{viewerId} OR NOT EXISTS
                   (SELECT 1 FROM member_block b
                    WHERE (b.blocker_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocked_id = p.author_id)
                       OR (b.blocked_id = #{viewerId} AND b.blocker_id = p.author_id)))
          </if>
    </select>

    <update id="increaseViewCount">
        UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>

    <select id="findMemberId" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId}
    </select>
    <select id="selectPublicByAuthorAndBoard" resultType="org.example.post.PostHeadlineRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, m.nickname AS author_nickname, b.slug AS board_slug
        FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
                    JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id
        WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND b.slug = #{boardSlug}
          AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
          AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
    </select>
    <select id="findBoardIdBySlug" resultType="long">
        SELECT id FROM board WHERE slug = #{slug}
    </select>

    <select id="findViewableByBoard" resultType="org.example.post.PostListRow">
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.excerpt, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.published_at,
               m.id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname
        FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id
        <where><include refid="listWhere"/></where>
        ORDER BY p.published_at DESC, p.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>

    <select id="countViewableByBoard" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p
        <where><include refid="listWhere"/></where>
    </select>

    <!-- 8-4: 검색과 COUNT에 같은 WHERE 조각을 적용한다. 태그는 EXISTS로 검사해 글이 중복되지 않는다. -->
    <sql id="searchWhere">
        <include refid="viewableWhere"/>
        <if test="condition.boardId != null">AND p.board_id = #{condition.boardId}</if>
        <if test="condition.authorId != null">AND p.author_id = #{condition.authorId}</if>
        <if test="fromAt != null">AND p.published_at >= #{fromAt}</if>
        <if test="toExclusive != null">AND p.published_at < #{toExclusive}</if>
        <if test="qPattern != null">AND LOWER(p.title) LIKE #{qPattern} ESCAPE '!'</if>
        <if test="condition.tag != null and condition.tag != ''">
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_tag pt JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
                        WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND t.name = #{condition.tag})
        </if>
    </sql>
